products.name: Frase
products.note: SEO content AI; SERP analysis; competitive data scraping; search algorithm dependency

profile_text.body:
Frase is a content platform built around SEO and what it calls generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO). The company describes itself as a content operating system for AI search, covering research, writing, optimization, publishing, and monitoring in a single workflow. It positions its core product as a replacement for multiple separate tools, and its site states that plans open at $39 per month billed yearly, with a Professional tier at $103 per month and a 20 percent saving for annual billing.

The Frase product performs site audits by crawling pages and scoring them for both SEO and AI readiness, then ranks fixes by estimated impact. It tracks Google rankings alongside AI citation presence across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI on a daily basis, alerting users when their share of voice changes. Frase also describes building a brand voice profile from a customer's existing published content so that drafts reflect the customer's own style. The platform supports writing natively in more than 70 languages and offers variable levels of publishing autonomy that users can adjust. It can be operated through an MCP server, a command-line interface, and an API, and the site notes compatibility with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP tools.

The held facts confirm that Frase is tracked in the site's product registry under the Writing and Editing category, with notes referencing SERP analysis, competitive data scraping, and search algorithm dependency. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
